paper: TCAFF: Temporal Consistency for Robot Frame Alignment, ICRA 2025, arXiv v3
primary_scope: Released map-and-frame-alignment pipeline on the author's saved FastSAM detections for the four-robot record
primary_metric: Mean of per-directed-pair mean SE(2) translation and yaw errors, as in the released demo
metric_conditioning: Only updates with an accepted estimate and available GT; always also report estimate availability
supplemental_metrics: Pooled errors over all valid pair-updates
paper_release_difference: Article section IV lists tau=8; the release YAML uses main_tree_obj_req=9. Release tau=9 is primary; tau=8 is a labeled filter-only control on the same saved proposals.
randomness: Unchanged upstream CLIPPER random_device; save all proposals and verify deterministic replay through the original manager factory
verification: All 4044 stored pair-updates reproduce the captured filter output
next_hypothesis: Audit view-dependent object representation in TCAFF using synchronized RGB/depth and manually verified physical object correspondence; ROMAN supplies related-work examples only
